description: This file contains benchmarking functions for various tensor operations in PyTorch specifically targeting the MPS backend. It defines performance measurement functions for unary, binary, reduction, and scan operations, and includes an executable main() function to run a series of benchmarks and compare different configurations.

methods.name: Measurement bench_unary_op(func, x, label)
methods.description: Performs benchmarking of a unary tensor operation using torch.utils.benchmark Timer.

methods.name: Measurement bench_binary_op(func, x, y, label)
methods.description: Performs benchmarking of a binary tensor operation using torch.utils.benchmark Timer.

methods.name: list[Measurement] bench_unary( unary_func, device: str = "mps", dtype: torch.dtype = torch.float32 )
methods.description: Sets up tensors and invokes bench_unary_op for different tensor configurations, returning a list of measurements.

methods.name: list[Measurement] bench_binary( binary_func, device: str = "mps", dt_a: torch.dtype = torch.float32, dt_b: Optional[torch.dtype] = None, )
methods.description: Sets up tensors and invokes bench_binary_op for different tensor configurations, returning a list of measurements.

methods.name: check_eager_vs_compile(rc_c, rc_e, func, dtype)
methods.description: Compares results from eager execution and TorchScript-compiled functions, issuing warnings if they differ.

methods.name: list[Measurement] bench_reduction( reduction_func, device: str = "mps", dtype: torch.dtype = torch.float32 )
methods.description: Benchmark reduction operations (like sum or max) over tensors with different sizes and compare eager vs compiled.

methods.name: list[Measurement] bench_scan( scan_func, device: str = "mps", dtype: torch.dtype = torch.float32, with_indices: bool = False, )
methods.description: Benchmark scan operations (like cumsum) along different dimensions and sizes, with or without indices.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main function to run comprehensive benchmarks on various tensor operations for the MPS backend and output comparison reports.
